scope: Historical provisional source review of ordinary mutable caller-binding reuse in the seven V2-8H public operations.

findings.title: Capture one private binding before asynchronous operation work
findings.detail: Backend authorization and state load/save use a copied A binding, but clear closures reread the caller's reused B binding. An A-authorized operation deletes B chat rows and leaves A rows under a new conversation generation, breaking subsequent A reads.

independentReproduction.backend: transactional in-memory fixture, no database or service
